Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll

## Function-Based Enzyme Generation

Function-Based Enzyme Generation

Exact job name: `Function_Based_Enzyme_Generation`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes | value | EC number a.b.c.d. |
| `n_samples` | integer | yes | value | Number of sequences |
| `file_format` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | `"csv"` (default) |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "description": "EC number a.b.c.d.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "n_samples": {
      "description": "Number of sequences",
      "type": "integer",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "file_format": {
      "description": "`\"csv\"` (default)",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "csv"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "label",
    "n_samples"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "Function_Based_Enzyme_Generation",
  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",

  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

Preserve every returned artifact link; download and inspect requested outputs before reporting success.

## Genzyme Generation

Generate candidate enzyme structures conditioned on substrate and product SMILES.

Exact job name: `Genzyme_Generation`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_substrate` | string | yes | value | Substrate SMILES. |
| `input_product` | string | yes | value | Product SMILES. |
| `num_structures` | integer | yes | value | Number of enzyme structures to generate; product validation range is 1–100000 |
| `complex_generation` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | Accepted as `"True"` by the verified submission, but absent from the product-sheet schema; omit unless the user explicitly requests it |
| `top_k` | integer | no / mode-dependent | value | Accepted as `2` by the verified submission, but absent from the product-sheet schema; omit unless the user explicitly requests it |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.
